mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Goods and Services (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month indicates strengthening consumer demand, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) for two consecutive months signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates inflationary pressure, which can lead to tightening monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which is likely to boost consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months indicates a strengthening housing market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth rate falls below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) also declines for two consecutive months, it signals a significant economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC of the signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year period.
